name: v0.1.23
body:
## StrikeHub v0.1.23

### Downloads

| Platform | Architecture | Download |
|----------|--------------|----------|
| macOS DMG | Apple Silicon | `StrikeHub-*-aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS DMG | Intel | `StrikeHub-*-x86_64.dmg` |
| macOS | Apple Silicon | `strikehub-darwin-aarch64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | Intel | `strikehub-darwin-x86_64.tar.gz` |
| Linux AppImage | x86_64 | `StrikeHub-*-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Linux AppImage | aarch64 | `StrikeHub-*-aarch64.AppImage` |
| Windows MSI | x86_64 | `strikehub-windows-x86_64.msi` |

All packages include bundled connectors (`ks-connector` and `pentest-agent`) and pre-configured environment variables.
- **`.msi`** — Windows installer with Start Menu, desktop shortcut, and system env vars
- **`.AppImage`** — Portable Linux package: runs out of the box on stock Ubuntu 22.04/26.04, including minimal/server images (zero extra packages — the full GTK/WebKit/graphics runtime is bundled). Building from source instead? Install `libegl1 libgbm1 libwayland-client0 ca-certificates libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0` first (desktop)

<!--
Docker instructions hidden from the rendered release until the published
image path works end-to-end (private ghcr package, never QA'd as a customer
path) — see issue #105. Retained verbatim for one-line re-enable:

  docker pull ghcr.io/Strike48-public/strikehub:0.1.23
-->

### Helm

```bash
helm install strikehub chart/strikehub \
  --set image.tag=0.1.23
```

### Checksums

See individual `.sha256` files for checksums.


## What's Changed
* docs: make release install instructions match shipped artifacts by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/104
* fix(msi): bundle app-local VC++ CRT so clean Windows installs launch by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/106
* fix(appimage): bundle the full graphics runtime closure so the AppImage works on stock Ubuntu by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/107
* fix(security): refuse unverified connector installs; atomic install with read-back verify by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/114
* fix(ux/stability): process-group safety, clean file logs, correct app id, work-area window by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/110
* feat(login): one-line account-requirement explainer on the sign-in screen by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/113
* ci: static FUSE-3 type2 runtime for AppImages (stock Ubuntu 24.04+) by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/112
* fix(signin): loopback ephemeral OAuth callback + cancellable 15-min waiting state by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/111
* fix(fetch): extract the connector tarball whole (lib/ survives) — atomic install by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/117
* fix(lifecycle): tear down the whole spawned process tree on close (unix groups + windows job object) by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/116
* chore: bump PICK_REF to v0.1.14-rc.1 (for the strikehub RC) by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/118
* fix(msi): find the VC++ redist on GH runners (vc-runtime staging broke the rc cut) by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/119
* fix(crt-guard): locate dumpbin via vswhere/globs — runner layout broke verify-crt-coverage by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/120
* fix(lifecycle): teardown on quit-event + managed-root sweep (RC QA caught mac orphan) by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/121
* chore: bump PICK_REF to v0.1.14 (speculative — official release companion) by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/123


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/compare/v0.1.22...v0.1.23

  --set image.tag=v0.1.22

### Checksums

See individual `.sha256` files for checksums.


## What's Changed
* fix(build): bundle Pick connector via renamed pick-agent-* archive by @jtomek-strike48 in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/67
* fix(signin): retry transient failures during Keycloak discovery by @edbonddevo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/94
* fix(build): build Linux AppImages on 22.04 and guard the glibc floor by @jtomek-strike48 in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/90
* security(ci): add PII-name scanner + CI check (port of pick#336) by @jtomek-strike48 in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/59
* fix(preflight): name the failed prerequisite in step 2 health hint by @jtomek-strike48 in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/85
* fix(preflight): keep wizard on Device Posture until checks report by @jtomek-strike48 in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/79
* feat(preflight): confirm before skipping failing device checks by @jtomek-strike48 in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/86
* fix(preflight): suggest approving a registration only when it can help by @jtomek-strike48 in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/88
* fix(preflight): say why a connector is not running, and where logs are by @jtomek-strike48 in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/87
* fix(sentry): break the connector-start effect feedback loop that floods Sentry with error events by @svc-engineering-strike48-ai in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/75
* fix(preflight): land stacked #86 content into main (bridge) — carries #86 skip-confirm by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/96
* fix(preflight): land stacked #86/#87/#88 content into main (bridge) by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/95
* ci(pii-scan): skip name scan on fork PRs where secrets are unavailable by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/97
* fix(sentry): make session tracking actually produce sessions (DAU/crash-free) (#73) by @svc-engineering-strike48-ai in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/76
* build(nix): scope desktop runtime libs off the global env by @jtomek-strike48 in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/70
* security(sentry): stop attaching real email/username to the global scope and logs (#72) by @svc-engineering-strike48-ai in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/74
* chore: bump PICK_REF to v0.1.12 by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/99
* fix(msi): map prerelease versions to WiX-numeric ProductVersion by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/100
* fix(appimage): make the AppImage start on Ubuntu 26.04 / pristine 22.04 (bundled WebKit helper deps + rpath) by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/102
* fix(preflight): require a sandbox only on Windows (WSL or Docker); stop the Docker nag on macOS/Linux by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/101
* chore: bump PICK_REF to v0.1.13 by @josh-devo in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/103

## New Contributors
* @svc-engineering-strike48-ai made their first contribution in https://github.com/Strike48-public/strikehub/pull/75
